releases.displayName: KOTCL Developer Diaries: Life After the Patch

items.text: Last Friday, we released a mega-patch that revamped all the events in the game. We hibernated for the weekend and dreamt of new cards and a bug-free game...

We woke up in a new world. Your feedback on the patch charged us up better than the golem core itself—and this week has borne more fruit than the gardens of the gardener orc. Want to know how we spent the last 7 days? Here’s a quick recap!
Hunting bugs (at this point, we’re not sure who’s the hunter and who’s the prey 😅)
Planning the DLC release. As Mortis says, a good route is half the victory!
Working on balance adjustments. THE GREAT NERF IS COMING!
Preparing a Valentine's Day surprise for you. You’ll find out about it next Friday!
Forward, friends! Join us on a perilous trek through the Rotten Bog, a fierce contest between orcs and demons, and, of course, a review of new enemies and the latest game news. Let’s go!

notes.title: New Lands Emerging in the Rotten Bog!

items.text: New locations will soon appear on the map—here’s a glimpse of one of them. We’re eager to create a full-fledged landscape for complete immersion in the atmosphere of Midian!
We draw inspiration from Caspar David Friedrich and John Constable—any other artists you’d recommend?

We pour our hearts and souls into every detail, striving for an authentic sense of presence. We want you to not just play but be there—to stand on the swampy ground, watching the sunset, inhaling the damp air. But something still feels missing… Tell us, who would you place in this clearing? What do you think of the new illustration?

notes.title: The Orc Spearman Pays a Visit to the Demons?

items.text: Your relationship with the Orc Spearman is about to level up. You’ll be able to journey with him from the Steppes all the way to the Northern Gate! Get ready for endless stories of his exploits—like the legendary saga of how he jabbed an overgrown worm with his spear. You’ll have to listen to it all the way to the Castle (our condolences)…
But just imagine how he’ll sing of your deeds! Despite having no ear for music whatsoever, he might just compose an orc version of Toss a Coin to Your Witcher—about you!
And of course, he’ll always be there to lighten the mood after battle and break up Mortis’ heavy dialogues—not unlike Donkey from Shrek.
His sagas will be hard to forget, and his strength could turn the tide of battle at a crucial moment! So get ready for new storylines with the Orc Spearman!

notes.title: The Mother of Imps Has a… New Addition?

items.text: The Northern Gate is now home to more than just orcs… The Castle has become so beloved by imps that they’re moving in with their entire families! Fighting travelers has become a family business for them, so brace yourselves—you’ll soon face young imps with new abilities!

We’re preparing an ultimate alchemical reset! The cauldrons are bubbling, potion-makers are drenched in sweat, and soon you’ll be able to create your potion-making hits… But be extremely careful! Science is a tricky matter, so the trial-and-error method might turn out to be a little… painful.
Expect enhanced recovery elixirs which will not only restore HP, but also provide nice buffs. The catch is that you’ll have to make them using human (and not only human) blood.
Will you dare pick up the mortar and pestle?
Hey everyone, it’s Andrew aka Innrey!
Last Friday, we released this massive patch and then went into hibernation over the weekend. When we woke up, our phones were flooded with notifications.
Bugs…

We’re receiving about 2 bug reports per hour, and I just want to say how much we appreciate you sending them in. That helps us immensely. We’ll fix the issues very soon. And while we’re testing solutions, here’s a status report on some temporary new dangers in the lands of Midian:
Worm-Trawling Bug
We recommend you avoid worm hunting for a while! Due to an anomaly in magical activity across the Crimson Steppes, the “Worm Trawling” event may experience bugs.
Code Fragments on Cards

Since Midian is a highly multicultural world, with an endless variety of languages, you may occasionally notice mysterious inscriptions on familiar cards. Please don’t be alarmed! The thing is we translate for you from dwarvish, orcish, goblin, elven, and even demonic dialects, and sometimes minor discrepancies occur.
Invisible Cards
Or new tricks of the crazy Court Mage…
We sincerely apologize for these bugs. Our team is small, but we’re working tirelessly to fix each and every error. A patch with fixes is coming soon.

Once again, thank you for your patience, bug reports, comments, and feedback. They mean the world to us and inspire us to keep going. As soon as we get the bugs under control, we’ll continue expanding the game—and we’d love to hear from you:
How do you like the patch?
What do you think of the new battle log and event log?
What were you expecting but didn’t quite get?

And now, an important confession… We’ve studied your comments, held counsel, ran tests, and… my friends, I was mortified by your secret that was revealed to me. Please, look me in the eyes and tell me honestly…
How many times have you farmed that imbalanced set? How many times have you taken the same routes? Hunted the same elves?
Today, it’s time to put an end to this! Very soon, “the-imba-from-the-Frontier” will be no more! Get ready! We’re reworking…
The Spry Elven Set!
I’ve realized that I can’t avoid responsibility for this gear set any longer. Soon, it will be mercilessly nerfed (but other sets will also be improved)!
We’re also preparing a little Valentine’s Day surprise for you—I’m going to continue working on it right now. :)
See you in the next dev diary!

notes.title: How to join the open beta test

items.text: 🔸 Launch Steam and right-click on Knock on the Coffin Lid.
🔸 Select Properties and go to the betas tab.
🔸 Next to “Beta Testing,” choose the branch “public_beta - public beta branch.”
🔸 Wait for Steam to update.
Important: The beta version is intended for Windows only and may contain bugs. Therefore, before installing the beta, please finish your current runs and back up the "Knock" save folder located at:
C:\Users\AppData\LocalLow\RedBoon\Knock
If any issues arise with the beta version, you can disable it at any time and return to the main branch
If you encounter any bugs or want to share your feedback, you can:
1. Use the “Bug report” feature in the game menu after pressing Esc.
2. Describe the issue in the “Open Beta Test” thread in the Steam Community Discussions.
3. Contact us in our Discord server
4. (If the above doesn’t work) Email us at 4knockbugs@gmail.com with the contents of your “Knock” folder attached.

releases.displayName: Huge update of Open Beta Test

items.text: Knock-knock, travelers! This wonderful day can become even more wonderful with our help as we’d like to release a huge update for Open Beta Test! So, prepare for a quite long patchnote to read. Shall we start?

🔸 New balance, which affected the whole game: biome maps, sets, and off-set items, amulets, enemies, cards for hero decks and even heroes themselves (Bjorn has 1 less draw , class items of Vanadis (Survivor) and Percival (Golddigger) that were set items are now new) - all have been changed
🔸 Routes have become shorter, which has shortened the run time
🔸 Added icons of event designation (after the first visit to the event in the next races the corresponding icon will be visible on the map)
🔸 Cards for decks, items and sets have been massively updated too (Troll items now don't count as a set)
🔸 Added version control for the current run (if the run was started in a different version of the game, a recommendation to start a new one will appear when trying to continue)
🔸 Disabled setting of weights in free run
🔸 Glossary. But be warned, it is still in the process of finalization, so it may not always work correctly

🔸 Event log is available, which accompanies the player during the whole run. The log contains brief descriptions of the events attended and what happened. It is designed to help players keep track of key moments, plot reveals, and important points. The event log displays information pertaining to a specific biome

🔸Significant improvements have been made to the visual display system for combat effects. We paid special attention to eliminating the problem of non-obviousness, which was mentioned by players in their suggestions and during the streamings

Previously, only icons were used to display buffs and debuffs, but they were too small. We have expanded the range of visual elements that help players better understand the current state of events in battle

Now during the battle you will see a text line that will gradually disappear, as well as clear visual effects. In addition, familiar icons have been given extra emphasis when appearing at the start of battle to make it easier for players to navigate
🔸 Most events have received long-awaited improvements. If you notice discrepancies, such as missing buttons or mixed-up dialogues, or if something seems illogical, please report it.

🔸 New Spine animations have been added to units. The old animation method restrained our development, so we decided to switch to Spine. This decision not only allowed us to create more vibrant and high-quality 2D animations but also sped up the animation process for game elements and events in 4 times. Unfortunately, we had to rebuild almost all animations in the game, so if you notice any bugs, strange animation speed, or jitteriness, please report them immediately!

🔸 Added animations, music and sounds to many events, such as "WhoCares", "Armory", "Last Flight", "Elixir of Growth", "Mushrooms", "Gram or Gorbigon? ", "Humiliation", "Alchemist", "Sad Troll", "Father and Son", "Scout", "Peace Pipe", "Ritual", "Abandoned Village", and many, many more.

🔸 Bjorn's Stun card now stuns enemies correctly
🔸 Intent tooltips are now dynamically resized, and additional special property windows open downwards and more than one (used to open sideways and only one)
🔸 Multiple card selections (e.g. to reset or to return from the Burned) now happen within a single panel (previously a separate panel for each card)
🔸 Fixed the position of the tooltip, with the description of set items in the inventory, previously could be displayed below the screen
